title: Indexing a Pointwise List Combination
statement: Let $f$ be a function from pairs of natural numbers to natural numbers, and let $l_1,l_2$ be lists of natural numbers. If $j$ is less than the length of each list, then the element at index $j$ of the list formed by applying $f$ pointwise to $l_1$ and $l_2$, with $0$ as the default out of range, equals $f$ applied to their respective elements at index $j$, each read with default $0$.
